featured_reviews.name: Deepika Pote
featured_reviews.review_text:
There are moments in life when your mind feels trapped in an endless loop of thoughts… when problems don’t just stay outside, they follow you everywhere. That’s exactly where we were... when we decided to try the Kohinoor room at Mystery Room, Andheri West..
and honestly, we didn’t realize then how much we needed it.
From the moment we entered, the energy shifted. The staff welcomed us with such warmth..always smiling, patient, and genuinely excited for us. It didn’t feel like just another activity; it felt like someone quietly telling us, “You’re going to feel better here.”
And then the game began.
What I loved the most was how brilliantly the clues were designed...hilarious, clever, and surprisingly nostalgic.. It was a reminder ...It felt like everything I had ever studied, observed, or casually learned in life was suddenly coming together. Each puzzle wasn’t just a task...it was a spark. A distraction. A reminder that the mind can still play, think, and solve… even when it feels heavy.
There were moments we laughed uncontrollably...cant tell you d exact details , moments we got stuck, and moments where we just looked at each other and said, “Wait… could it be this?” And when things started clicking, it wasn’t just about solving the room...it felt like breaking through something inside us. We dint panic ,got angry, or blamed each other but were focused on problem solving..
And then… that bell rang.
That sound ..it wasn’t just a signal that we had completed the task in hand... It was a jolt.... The exact jolt we didn’t know we needed... For those few minutes, we weren’t thinking about stress, worries, or anything weighing us down. We were just present, quick..and connected... We dint think ... We just did what needed to be done ..and laughed out our hearts....
We walked out lighter. Clearer. Almost reset.
If you’re feeling stuck, overwhelmed, or just mentally exhausted, this place is more than just an escape room. It’s a pause. A shift. A small but powerful break from the chaos inside your head.
For me and my sister, it wasn’t just an experience...it was a moment of healing.
A must-visit. Truly one of the best experiences we’ve ever had.

featured_reviews.name: Akash Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
The ultimate test of wits and teamwork: "The Kon of Kohinoor" at Mystery Rooms Andheri. My team and I took on this "Mission Impossible" with just one hour on the clock, and it was a total blast. The room was packed with intricate puzzles and clever clues that kept us on our toes every single second. It felt like we were in a real-life spy movie, racing against time to steal the diamond.
​What really made the experience stand out was the incredible staff. They were super friendly and right there to help whenever we got stuck, nudging us in the right direction without giving anything away. Their support was crucial and made the whole thing so much more fun.
​If you're looking for an unforgettable adventure that's challenging, exciting, and full of laughs, you have to try this. It's truly a crazy fun experience that I'd recommend to everyone. We're already planning our next mission!!!

featured_reviews.name: Pinkesh Kamwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a great time at Mystery Rooms Andheri. We played two games — Abduction and Night in Bhangarh, and both offered very different but equally exciting experiences.

Abduction was more of a pure mind game, focused on solving puzzles and thinking logically as a team — really engaging and satisfying.

Night in Bhangarh was the highlight for all of us — slightly spooky with dark horror themes, adding an extra thrill. The experience of crawling through spaces, solving clues, and escaping under pressure made it super immersive and fun.

Overall, a perfect mix of challenge, teamwork, and thrill. Great place to visit with friends if you enjoy puzzle-solving and a bit of adventure 👍

featured_reviews.name: Amit Agrawal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Escapeverse and chose the "Murder on Eclipse Express" room. Based on the marketing and hype around their use of advanced technology and sensors, I had high expectations. Unfortunately, the experience did not justify the price we paid.

While the room does use a few sensors and automated mechanisms to unlock doors, the technology itself is quite limited and does not significantly enhance the gameplay. The "latest technology" claim feels exaggerated compared to what is actually offered inside the room.

The biggest disappointment was the storyline. As a murder mystery-themed escape room, I expected a logical and engaging investigation. Instead, many of the conclusions required players to make unrealistic assumptions, and the story progression often felt disconnected from the clues provided. Rather than rewarding logical thinking, several puzzles seemed to rely on guesswork. A good escape room should make players feel like detectives solving a mystery, but that feeling was largely missing here.

The room theme was "Murder on Eclipse Express," yet there was very little that made us feel like we were actually on a train. The ambience, setup, and overall immersion did not effectively support the theme. The train environment felt underdeveloped, which made it harder to connect with the story.

Another point worth mentioning is the room size. The space is quite limited and is best suited for 2–3 participants. Larger groups may find it cramped, with some members having little to do during certain parts of the game.

The overall condition of the premises was also disappointing. If you visit, I would recommend using the lift instead of the stairs, as the staircase were dirty and lighting was not there during our visit. Additionally, there were ants outside the room entrance, and some even got into my shoes, causing discomfort after leaving from venue. Basic cleanliness and hygiene around the venue should be maintained more carefully though inside cleanliness was good.

Finally, I was surprised by the handling of the payment receipt. After making payment, I requested a receipt but was initially told it could not be provided. It was only shared the following day via WhatsApp. A receipt should ideally be issued immediately upon payment.

Overall, I found Escapeverse to be significantly overhyped. The technology, storyline, immersion, venue maintenance, and customer service did not meet expectations for the amount charged. There is definitely room for improvement, particularly in creating a more logical story, enhancing the thematic experience, maintaining better hygiene, and providing a smoother customer experience.

featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: We are amazed to hear that you had a great experience at Rage Room. We aim to provide you the best and safe space to vent your emotions. We are happy to know that this was therapeutic. Looking forward for your next visit.

featured_reviews.name: Hitanshu Gandhi
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is an incredibly lovely concept. You just come in and unload your rage by breaking a delightful assortment of glass.

I highly recommend the 1500+GST package since by the time you get your grip on how to have fun, you are out of bottles.

I would also recommend you to borrow the sanitizer stand to use as a tripod for your videos!

somesh is a great host. Will visit again. He is very kind and friendly.

This is in a minor alley and up a flight of stairs but without any markings. Just ask the building guard if you feel lost

The air conditioning was terrible in my visit. Strongly suggest that you ask them to start it while they prep the room for you! Very annoying but somesh is a great host.

Please avoid wearing glasses because the face shields have a tendency to fog up given how excited we get. Please wear contact lenses if you can. Else they have a lovely Darth Vader mask for folks with spectacles.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you so much for your thoughtful and detailed review! 💥 We're thrilled you enjoyed the experience and loved your creative tip about the sanitizer stand — definitely a smart move!

Somesh will be so happy to hear your kind words — he truly goes the extra mile to make everyone feel welcome. Thanks also for your feedback on signage and the AC — we’re working on making both better!

Just a small note for future guests: even with the AC running, the room can get a bit hot and sweaty because of all the movement and the safety gear — it's part of the full-body catharsis! We recommend staying hydrated and taking it at your own pace.

Loved hosting you and we can't wait to see you again soon for another smashing session!

featured_reviews.name: Tushar Surti
featured_reviews.review_text: I had such an amazing time at the rage room! It was an incredibly enjoyable experience — I absolutely loved it. Definitely recommend this to anyone looking for a fun and unique way to blow off some steam!

featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited Rage Room Mumbai with a friend, and what an experience it was!😍 Located conveniently near Sakinaka Metro Station, this place offers the perfect outlet to vent out all your frustration and anger. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a unique way to release stress!👍🏻

featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an incredible experience at the Rage Room! From the moment I stepped in, the staff made me feel comfortable and explained everything clearly.

customer_updates.name: Shubhra Savla
customer_updates.text:
My recent trip to Coorg with DreamEscape was nothing short of amazing! The entire experience was so well-organized — right from the travel to the stay, everything was seamless and smooth. Though I was the solo traveller the team was incredibly friendly and made sure everyone felt comfortable and taken care of throughout the journey.

The stay was an absolute highlight — the view was so sexy (yes, that’s the word!) and truly felt like a dream. Waking up to that view every day felt like therapy in itself.

Overall, the trip felt like a beautiful blend of adventure and meditation. It was totally worth every bit — peaceful, fun, and soul-refreshing. Can’t wait to travel with DreamEscape specially with Akshay and Harshad again!

customer_updates.name: Surecta Dmello
customer_updates.text: I recently went on the Kalsubai trek. As a solo female traveler, safety is always a concern for me. However, the trek leader made sure to take all necessary precautions and ensured that I felt comfortable throughout the trek.The food provided during the trek was nice. The trek itself was challenging but the views from the top of Kalsubai were absolutely breathtaking. Overall, the entire experience was fantastic. I highly recommend Dream Escape for everyone.

featured_reviews.name: Asvita Tamhane
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an amazing time in Ganpatipule,Malvan, sindhudurga! Nachiketa Resort was fantastic at Malvan, great service and beautiful views. Our driver was super helpful and made the trip even more enjoyable🫶. Loved the local food and the boat rides were a highlight!  thanks to Dream Escape!✨️ Only minor drawback was that a carriage for luggage would've been nice, but we managed. 5-star trip for sure!✌️

featured_reviews.name: Priya Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a wonderful experience on my recent trip to Coorg with Dream Escape. Our trip lead Akshay was extremely supportive, friendly, and guided the group very smoothly throughout the journey. He made the trip fun and stress-free. The homestays were very pleasant and comfortable, which added to the overall experience. Truly looking forward to traveling again with Dream Escape!

featured_reviews.name: Shafali Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: Thank you so much for this amazing getaway Akshay. All the arrangements were really good- from Food, to travel to hospitality to camping! This was my first time in a nature camp and a first ever experience for my 6 yr old son. We both had a blast!! Being a solo female traveller along with my son, i have never felt so safe and comfortable, owing to the fact that i knew no one. You were more like a friend to me than a trip manager. Going forward, i am definitely going to recommend you for group trips and such getaways. Looking forward to planning more amazing experiences with you and your team.

featured_reviews.name: Shivani Khaladkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently went on a trip to Malvan-Ratnagiri organized by Dream Escape, and it was an amazing experience! Everything was well-planned and perfectly executed. The stay at Nachiketa Resort was very comfortable – the ambiance was very peaceful, just what we needed.

They covered almost all the points mentioned in the itinerary. A special shout-out to our driver, who was super cool, friendly, and made us feel really comfortable throughout the journey.

Overall, it was a memorable trip with great arrangements, and we’re really happy we chose Dream Escape. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Pranali Bhagat
featured_reviews.review_text: We recently took a Bhandardara trip with Dreams Escape, and it turned out to be one of the best trips we've ever had. The management was excellent ...they covered almost all the major spots from the itinerary on time without rushing us like many other groups do. We had ample time to enjoy the place and click some beautiful pictures. The food was also delicious and unlimited, adding to the overall experience. Truly worth every penny!

featured_reviews.name: Samruddhi raut
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing experience with Camping Fireflies at Bhandardara! ✨🪄
Everything was well-organized, from the campsite setup to the food and activities. The staff was friendly, helpful, and made sure everyone was comfortable throughout the trip.
The highlight of the experience was definitely witnessing thousands of fireflies lighting up the night—it felt like stepping into a dream. The peaceful surroundings, starry sky, campfire, music, and great company made the entire experience unforgettable.
Thank you, Camping Fireflies, for creating such beautiful memories. Highly recommended for anyone looking to escape city life and experience nature's magic up close! 🌿✨🏕️
A trip I'll cherish forever. ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Jvelika Raul
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently took a trip to Gokarna organized by Akshay at Dream Escape, and it was an amazing experience! The trip was well-planned, with seamless coordination throughout. He was friendly, knowledgeable, and ensured everything went smoothly.

We enjoyed beautiful beaches, explored historic temples, and had a comfortable stay. The trekking, cave explorations, backwater boating, and the visit to the fort were unforgettable highlights. Everything was well-organized, and there were no compromises on quality.

I highly recommend Dream Escape for anyone looking for a relaxing yet adventurous getaway. Truly the best travel agency!

featured_reviews.name: Akanksha Birwadkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing experience at the Bhandardara Fireflies Camping festival! The entire event was well organized, from the campsite setup to the activities. Watching thousands of fireflies light up the night was truly magical and something I'll remember for a long time.

The location was beautiful, the food was good, and the organizers ensured everything ran smoothly. lakeside views, and the overall atmosphere made the trip even more special. A big thanks to the team for creating such a memorable experience.

Highly recommended for anyone looking to escape the city, connect with nature, and witness the incredible firefly season. Looking forward to joining again next year!
